listing.name: Killer Instinct 2 (arcade) (UltraCombo)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Distinct implementation from kilnan/ki-recomp #2246. Requires two game+implementation canonical records despite single Quiver row; preserve disk/saves distinctions. Limits: Prerelease1.1.0 supports two distinct arcade games; startup prepares game/sound code. Independent of ki-recomp. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP (MinGW-w64 build documented), Linux archive/AppImage. Selected Linux artifact CPU unknown in frozen release research. Original data: Own Killer Instinct2 arcade kinst2 boot/sound ROM set and matching CHD or raw disk image. UltraCombo prepares selected game/sound code on first launch; original Killer Instinct kinst files do not substitute. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
